question: how many orders got cancelled in 2017
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'canceled' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'
notes: status canceled; period by purchase date

question: which state do most of our customers live in

question: quick one, how many sellers r in RJ

question: on avg how many items are in a delivered order
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
notes: items per order over orders with status delivered

question: whats the top 5 categories by items sold this yr (2018)
gold_sql: SELECT p.category_en FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01' AND p.category_en IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5
notes: items = order_items rows; all statuses (no named rule)

question: what % of orders paid w credit card at least once
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN o.order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
gold_columns: ((100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE  WHEN ((p.payment_type = 'credit_card')) THEN (o.order_id) ELSE NULL END)) / count(DISTINCT o.order_id))
notes: percentage asked, so 0-100; all orders, all time

question: how many 5 star reviews did we get in 2017?

notes: no date named, so period by order purchase date (dictionary rule)

question: late delivery rate for nov 2017 orders?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-12-01'
gold_columns: avg(CASE  WHEN ((CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE))) THEN (1.0) ELSE 0.0 END)
notes: fraction; delivered orders with a delivery date

question: hey how many active sellers in SP rn

question: what % of customers r repeat customers
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1) SELECT 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM c
notes: percentage; all time; among customers with a valid order (same as the repeat-share template)

question: how many low ratings came in last qtr (going by review date)
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r WHERE r.review_score <= 2 AND r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2018-04-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-07-01'

question: avg delivery time in days for orders from march 2018
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(date_diff('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-03-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-04-01'

question: which seller state had the worst late rate in 2017? only states w 100+ delivered orders pls
gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, s.seller_state, CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS late FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01') SELECT seller_state FROM t GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY AVG(late) DESC LIMIT 1

question: can u do month over month GMV growth % for 2018 thru aug
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-12-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01' GROUP BY 1), g AS (SELECT month, 100.0 * (gmv - LAG(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS growth FROM m) SELECT month, growth FROM g WHERE month >= '2018-01' ORDER BY month
notes: percent; Jan 2018 compared with Dec 2017; 8 rows

question: top 3 categories by GMV per region in 2017
gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT r.region, p.category_en, SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.state = c.customer_state JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01' AND p.category_en IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2), k AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS rn FROM t) SELECT region, category_en FROM k WHERE rn <= 3

question: who were our top 10 sellers by revenue in FY17
gold_sql: SELECT i.seller_id FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-02-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(i.price) DESC LIMIT 10

question: do late orders get worse reviews? avg score late vs on time
gold_sql: WITH d AS (SELECT o.order_id, CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS late FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN d.late = 1 THEN r.review_score END) AS late_avg, AVG(CASE WHEN d.late = 0 THEN r.review_score END) AS on_time_avg FROM reviews r JOIN d ON d.order_id = r.order_id
notes: one row, two values; delivered orders with a delivery date; averaged over review rows

question: how many customers placed their first order in 2017 and then ordered again in 2018
gold_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_ts, MAX(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in18 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f WHERE first_ts >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND first_ts < DATE '2018-01-01' AND in18 = 1

question: what % of 2017 GMV came from just the top 20 sellers
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT i.seller_id, SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT SUM(gmv) FROM (SELECT gmv FROM s ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 20)) / SUM(gmv) FROM s
gold_columns: ((100.0 * (SELECT sum(gmv) FROM (SELECT gmv FROM s ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 20))) / sum(gmv))

question: for stuff shipped by SP sellers, which 5 customer states wait the longest on avg
gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, c.customer_state, date_diff('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS d FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND s.seller_state = 'SP') SELECT customer_state FROM t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY AVG(d) DESC LIMIT 5
notes: delivery time per distinct order; all time

question: avg amount paid per order when a voucher was used
gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT p.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS paid FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM payments WHERE payment_type = 'voucher') GROUP BY 1) SELECT AVG(paid) FROM t
notes: total paid per order (all payment rows) for orders with a voucher payment

question: whats the avg review score per order for MG sellers
gold_sql: WITH per AS (SELECT r.order_id, AVG(r.review_score) AS sc FROM reviews r WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT i.order_id FROM order_items i JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id WHERE s.seller_state = 'MG') GROUP BY 1) SELECT AVG(sc) FROM per
notes: 'per order': average each order's reviews first, then average over orders
